decision_conditions: The proposed variation of condition 2 in respect of amendments to allow additions of photovoltaic panel cells to roof and installation of 6 X air source heat pumps within cabinets would fall outside the scope of the approved description of development under planning permission P/2840/21 (dated 14/10/21).  The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Notwithstanding reason for refusal 1 above, the proposed solar panels due to their angled and raised appearing, together with their coverage and siting on the roof  would by unduly obtrusive, incongruous and out of keeping with the appearance of the host building and wider street scene, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), policy D3.D (11) of The London Plan (2021), policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM1 of the Development Management Local Plans Policies (2013) and adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).

Notwithstanding reason for refusal 1 above, in the absence of a detailed noise report including any necessary mitigation measures, the Local Planning Authority is unable to make a full assessment of the impacts of the proposed heat pumps on the residential amenities of adjoining neighbours with regard to noise and disturbance, contrary to Policy D3 D(9) of The London Plan 2021 and Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission P/4746/21 dated 17/11/2022 to allow addition of photovoltaic panels cells to roof; installation of 6 X air source heat pumps within cabinets; fenestration alterations and additions to improve light ingress; internal alterations
